novelty.justification: The claim predicts "a sparse set of 'result-carrying' tokens whose corruption flips the answer and whose attention is necessary," so its novelty route is a token-level causal measurement of CoT computation rather than a wholly new faithfulness question. Searches around "chain-of-thought token causal impact," "CoT attention knockout activation patching," "intermediate reasoning token corruption," and "load-bearing reasoning steps" identify Causal Abstraction for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Arithmetic Word Problems (2023) and Measuring Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning (2023) as the closest work: both already intervene on intermediate CoT content to determine whether models condition their answers on it, while the former explicitly studies whether CoT tokens causally implement the described reasoning. Moving to per-token attention read-back, activation patching, and a sparse load-bearing-token map is a non-trivial but natural mechanistic extension of that established question using standard interpretability tools, rather than a new core causal relationship.
